description: Get Out the Vote shifts on weekdays in Hastings at 12pm, 3pm and 5pm. Fridays run 12pm and 3pm only, Monday Nov 2 adds a 10am shift, and Election Day shifts are 8am, 10am, 2pm and 4pm. Pick a shift when you sign up. The meeting spot comes with your confirmation. No experience needed: there's a short training and all materials are provided.
